name: elancebot
description: Compliance-first freelance growth and website audit toolkit for user-provided data.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test tests/integration.mjs tests/seo.integration.mjs tests/insights.integration.mjs tests/experiments.integration.mjs tests/linkedin.integration.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/build-assets.mjs && wrangler deploy --env preview --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply elancebot-preview --env preview --remote
